poppkflow

Structured, iterative population PK model development with nlmixr2. Model development is a loop: specify a model, fit it, diagnose it, compare it with its parent, decide, and modify. poppkflow supports this loop and records it.

  • Declarative model specifications (pk_spec(), pk_add_iiv(), pk_add_cov(), …) instead of hand-edited model code.
  • A run ledger: ledger/runs.csv (one row per run: lineage, hashes, OFV, dOFV against the parent, flags, decision) plus ledger/events.csv (append-only audit trail) and RDS files per run (models/<run>/fit.rds, result.rds, spec.rds, …). Identical runs come from a cache.
  • Standard diagnostics, flags and suggestions for every run.
  • Comparison and decisions with rationale (pk_compare(), pk_decide()).
  • Covariate screening and stepwise covariate modelling, robustness checks (multiple starts, seeds), bootstrap, VPC, exposure.
  • A report generated from the ledger (pk_report()).

Example 

library(poppkflow)

proj <- pk_project("my_analysis")
pk_covariates(tibble::tribble(
  ~name , ~type         , ~ref,
  "WT"  , "continuous"  , 70  ,
  "CRCL", "continuous"  , 100 ,
  "SEXF", "categorical" , NA
))
dat <- pk_data(system.file("extdata", "example_pk.csv", package = "poppkflow"))
pk_check(dat)

# base model
r1 <- pk_run(pk_spec(ncmt = 2, lag = TRUE, iiv = c("ka", "cl", "v2")),
             note = "Base model", stage = "structural")
pk_diagnostics(r1)

# the data suggest a change: modify the parent and fit the candidate
r2 <- r1 |>
  pk_add_cov("cl", "WT", form = "power", init = 0.75) |>
  pk_inits_from(r1) |>
  pk_run(note = "WT on CL", stage = "covariate")

pk_compare(r1, r2)
pk_decide(r2, "accepted", reason = "dOFV < -6.63 for 1 df; plausible allometric effect")

pk_tree()
pk_history()

Development 

devtools::load_all()
devtools::test()                                 # fast tests with a stub fit function
Sys.setenv(POPPKFLOW_SLOW = "true"); devtools::test()   # also real nlmixr2 fits
